describe RingBuffer do
  it "starts empty with size 0" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(4)
    rb.empty?.should be_true
    rb.full?.should be_false
    rb.size.should eq 0
  end

  it "tracks size correctly after pushes" do
    rb = RingBuffer(String).new(3)
    rb.push("a")
    rb.size.should eq 1
    rb.push("b")
    rb.size.should eq 2
    rb.push("c")
    rb.size.should eq 3
    rb.full?.should be_true
    rb.empty?.should be_false
  end

  it "pops elements in FIFO order" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(3)
    rb.push(10)
    rb.push(20)
    rb.push(30)
    rb.pop.should eq 10
    rb.pop.should eq 20
    rb.pop.should eq 30
  end

  it "raises IndexError when popping from an empty buffer" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(2)
    expect_raises(IndexError, "buffer is empty") { rb.pop }
  end

  it "overwrites the oldest element when pushing to a full buffer" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(3)
    rb.push(1).push(2).push(3)
    rb.full?.should be_true
    rb.push(4) # overwrites 1
    rb.size.should eq 3
    rb.full?.should be_true
    rb.pop.should eq 2
    rb.pop.should eq 3
    rb.pop.should eq 4
  end

  it "maintains correct size after overwrite" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(2)
    rb.push(1).push(2)
    rb.push(3) # overwrites 1, size stays 2
    rb.size.should eq 2
  end

  it "supports push chaining (returns self)" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(5)
    result = rb.push(1).push(2).push(3)
    result.should be(rb)
    rb.size.should eq 3
  end

  it "correctly handles a capacity-1 buffer" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(1)
    rb.push(42)
    rb.full?.should be_true
    rb.push(99) # overwrites 42
    rb.pop.should eq 99
    rb.empty?.should be_true
  end

  it "correctly wraps around the ring multiple times" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(3)
    (1..9).each { |i| rb.push(i) }
    # After 9 pushes into capacity-3, last 3 pushed are 7, 8, 9
    rb.pop.should eq 7
    rb.pop.should eq 8
    rb.pop.should eq 9
  end

  it "works with a String generic type" do
    rb = RingBuffer(String).new(2)
    rb.push("hello").push("world")
    rb.pop.should eq "hello"
    rb.pop.should eq "world"
    rb.empty?.should be_true
  end

  it "interleaves push and pop correctly" do
    rb = RingBuffer(Int32).new(3)
    rb.push(1).push(2)
    rb.pop.should eq 1
    rb.push(3).push(4)
    rb.size.should eq 3
    rb.pop.should eq 2
    rb.pop.should eq 3
    rb.pop.should eq 4
  end
end

  TOKEN_PATTERNS = [
    {:number, /\A\d+/},
    {:word, /\A[a-zA-Z]+/},

    skip_whitespace

    end

    result = [] of NamedTuple(kind: Symbol, value: String)
    while tok = next_token
      result << tok
    end
    result
  end

  private def skip_whitespace : Nil

    end
  end

    @events = Deque(Time::Instant).new
